resources.string: Required in this test build. If you don\'t allow it, DashBuddy\'s Accessibility service turns itself off and the app can\'t be used until you allow it in Settings > Data & privacy > Automation & consent.

Choose which delivery apps DashBuddy reads. Shift tracking works only in apps DashBuddy fully supports.\n\nTest builds only: DashBuddy can save screen and notification text to improve how it reads each app, and its filters may miss customer details. That text stays on the phone until it is removed or the app is uninstalled, and Android backup and phone transfer leave it out. Census sharing is off unless turned on in developer options. When on, it sends filtered outlines of unrecognized screens to the census server, and, for a trusted install, their text. Regular builds save none of this text and upload nothing to the census.

Off unless you turn it on. A screenshot is saved only when this switch and its type below are on; the types start on.

A screenshot shows the whole screen, including customer details, other apps and anything else showing, like a video or the keyboard. It goes to Pictures/DashBuddy. DashBuddy never uploads it, but gallery sync or sharing can. Screenshots stay after you uninstall; delete them in your gallery.

None is taken if this switch is off or another app is in front at that moment; one already saving still finishes. This switch doesn't affect your shift history or test-build screen text.
